rachel_sec: Heads-up — saw ~1.6k TLS handshake rejects from eu-west -> svc-search starting ~2027-01-11T09:20Z. Logs show client cert CN=svc-search-stale and some TLS protocol mismatches. Could be related to the keystore regroup last week.

paul_sre: Can you paste a sample log line? Also check KMS decrypt audit for keystore-search-euw around the rotator window.

rachel_sec: Ingress excerpt: 
```
2027-01-11T09:21:02Z ingress-euw-2 svc-search="svc-search-01" tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate (client CN=svc-search-stale, expected svc-search)
2027-01-11T09:21:05Z ingress-euw-1 svc-search="svc-search-02" tls: handshake error: tls: unsupported protocol or cipher suite
```

anya_infra: We ran RBAC regroup on 2027-01-08 to move per-SA grants into group keystore-admins. There were a couple of emergency project-level grants in 2026 that I suspect weren't removed. I'll pull KMS audit now.

kms-bot: KMS audit (keystore-search-euw) 2027-01-11T03:40:00Z..03:46:00Z:
{"timestamp":"2027-01-11T03:44:58Z","principal":"svc-search-stale@infra.redwood","action":"Decrypt","resource":"projects/.../cryptoKeys/keystore-search-euw"}
{"timestamp":"2027-01-11T03:45:01Z","principal":"rotator-sa@infra.redwood","action":"Decrypt","resource":"projects/.../cryptoKeys/keystore-search-euw"}

paul_sre: That shows the stale SA still had decrypt rights and could mint certs during rotation. Mixed keymaterial/profiles could explain the cipher/negotiation oddities.

sam_devex: Short mitigation checklist: 1) remove lingering IAM member for svc-search-stale (anya), 2) run a canary rotation with rotator-sa only, 3) quick TLS probe to verify CN and TLS1.3 everywhere, 4) add KMS-decrypt alert that pages sec-oncall if decrypt principal not in allowlist, 5) add rotator pre-rotation IAM sanity check.

anya_infra: Removing legacy IAM member now. I'll also queue a terraform state prune and open a PR to purge the orphan binding.

kms-bot: note: removed iam member svc-search-stale@infra.redwood from key keystore-search-euw at 2027-01-11T09:29:12Z (operator=anya_infra).

rotator-bot: rotator: scheduled canary rotation keystore-search-euw-20270111-canary at 2027-01-11T03:50:00Z using rotator-sa@infra.redwood

rotator-bot: rotator: canary rotation completed at 2027-01-11T03:51:22Z. Issued certs with CN=svc-search (profile: tls1.3).

paul_sre: Quick probe: `openssl s_client -connect svc-search.euw.internal:443 -tlsextdebug -status` shows client cert CN=svc-search and TLSv1.3 handshake OK from eu-west probe. Reject rate back to baseline after 09:32Z.

rachel_sec: Root cause = lingering project-level IAM grant for legacy SA after RBAC consolidation. Contributing factors = no pre-rotation IAM sanity check and no alerting on unexpected KMS decrypt principals.

sam_devex: Follow-ups: sam to draft rotator pre-check RFC (fail-canary if unexpected principals present), anya to purge terraform orphan and add CI IAM-parity test, sec to add KMS-decrypt alert and weekly decrypt summary; infra to consider an automated KMS impersonation verifier (small script that attempts List/Decrypt with rotator-sa impersonation to validate exclusivity).

anya_infra: Opening PR to purge legacy binding + terraform state cleanup. Adding a short CI test that compares key IAM to expected allowlist post-apply.

rachel_sec: Filing P2 incident with timeline and audit snippets. Adding TLS hardening notes to runbook: enforce TLS1.3, disable legacy ciphers, enable OCSP stapling for rotator-issued certs, and ensure mTLS clients rotate within a brief overlap window.

paul_sre: Good catch. If anyone sees similar spikes in other regions, reuse this checklist and ping sec-oncall. :thumbsup:
